appDescription: Odee shares live positions and status of vehicles driving together as a group.

function.name: SHOW_GROUP_LOCATION
function.description: Shows where the other vehicles in the driving group are and their arrival times.

function.name: ANSWER_GROUP_ALERT
function.description: Answers the current group driving alert by accepting or declining the suggested route change.

decision.description: ACCEPT_AND_CALL adds the stop and connects a voice call, ACCEPT_ROUTE_ONLY adds the stop only, KEEP_ROUTE keeps the current route.
